_about: Every tuning number for the web game. The Swift package reads its own frozen copy (ios/tuning.json).

start._about: A new garden opens on a little grotto around the old log: scenery along its edge (visual only), and the opening's seed tin (Content/opening.json) on a free tile within tin.near of the old log.

garden._about: The garden. Plants (Content/plants.json) grow through stages (seed, sprout, bud, bloom, ready) over growHours on their own school's soil, timed from timestamps so time away counts. soil: growth speed on the plant's own soil (preferred), on plain soil (plain); on another school's soil it can't be planted at all. stages: the share of growth at which sprout, bud and bloom begin; ready at 1. A perennial regrows from the bud stage in regrowHours after each harvest. Per plant (plants): growHours, regrowHours (perennials), yield (produce per harvest), seeds [packets always returned, chance of one more], sell (coins per produce), packet (coins per seed packet in the Store). amendments: Store price per bag (plain loam is cheaper). sellByRarity: the price of anything else in the Bag that can be sold (foraged finds). startCoins: coins in a new garden. starterSet: what the opening's tin holds: packets of the chosen school's first starter plant (and one of its second, if it has one), packets of the runner-up school's first starter, and amendments of each. morning: after minAwayHours of real time away a card sums up what's ready; at most one surprise per local day, with surpriseChance, chosen by weight among the kinds possible right now.

forage._about: The foraging patch: a few plain finds turn up by chance on the clearing's outer ring, by the treeline. Every slotMinutes of game time (offline included, at most maxCatchUpSlots), each slot has `chance` of one find, up to `max` waiting at once. Which slot gets a find, the tile and the item are hashed from the garden seed and the slot, so it's deterministic. Tap to pick. Set enabled false to turn the patch off.

expansion._about: Room to grow (Store): each tier pushes the treeline back ringTiles on each side.

offerings._about: The Old Log board and Store (Resources/Content/requests.json, cosmetics.json from design/Undergrowth_Offerings.xlsx). Recolouring a placed decor prop costs recolorCost (0 = free).

visitors._about: Visitors (Content/visitors.json): forest animals that come to the grotto, mostly while the player is away. Separate from the Old Log's traders. Every checkMinutes of game time (offline catch-up included, up to maxCatchUpDays) each visitor's interest rises by interest.gain while the grotto meets its preferences (its school at its min intensity on at least minTiles tiles, or its named terrain there; and its liked find growing unpicked on that ground, if it has one; x rainMult in rain if it likes rain), and falls by interest.decay when it doesn't. Stages: signs (tracks appear on its ground during its time window, chance tracks.chance per check, fading after tracks.hours), clues (tapping tracks reads a clue that names a preference the player doesn't know yet; a liked find gets nibbled), present (in its time window, and in rain if it likes rain, it comes with presence.chance per check for presence.minutes, at most presence.perDay a day). Tapping a present visitor befriends it; befriended ones come more often (befriended*) and leave a gift (a liked find or a school seed) with gift.chance. firstVisitor: on the first return after the first relic, the visitor of that relic's school gets this much interest and its tracks circle the relic, one clue ready.

naming._about: A garden left unnamed takes its name from its most common soil (Content/nameParts.json).

clock._about: Real local time of day: the four lighting states and the visitors' time windows (dawn, day, dusk, night).

canopy._about: Tree shadows from design/shadow_overlay_v2.webp (processed by tools/gen_canopy.py into img/canopy.png: alpha = sunlight, texelsPerPx image px per art px, drawn smooth at up to maxRes buffer px per art px). Layer 1 at full strength, layer 2 offset/scaled/flipped and added at secondAlpha so the flecks never repeat on a grid, and a large soft region layer that lifts the shade in some areas (clearings).

lighting._about: Per state; values blend smoothly across clock.transitionMinutes around each boundary. shade/light = canopy shade and sunlight-patch strength (light is drawn with canopy.lightBlend); glow = warm glow on the brightest centres; shafts = strength of the diagonal light beams; classic = the earlier look's values (Debug: Sunlight classic). ambient multiplies the whole scene.
